Requirements Your Spellstrike is charged.

Your Spellstrike sweeps are so wide and devastating, they smash into nearby foes. Make a Spellstrike with a spell that can deal damage. Enemies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] around the target (not including the target) take 2 damage of the same damage type your spell could deal. This damage increases to 3 at 9th level, 4 at 14th level, and 5 at 19th level.

If you're in the Arcane Cascade stance, the emanation's damage gains a status bonus to damage equal to the extra damage from your Arcane Cascade.
